about: Which builds in a project folder only run on the user's macOS or Windows machine (src/box/host-builds.js in the CLI, apps/server/src/box/host-builds.ts in the desktop app read this same file). Linux hosts are never checked.

cli.native: This folder has {label} builds ({things}) that won't run in the Linux sandbox, so this chat runs on {machine}. `mars sandbox on` to use the sandbox here anyway.
cli.explicit: This chat runs in a Linux sandbox, but this folder has {label} builds ({things}) that won't run there; rebuilding them inside replaces them with Linux builds that won't run on {machine} (`mars --no-sandbox` runs it on {machine}).
cli.box: This chat runs in a Linux sandbox (this folder mounted, installs kept per folder); `mars --no-sandbox` or `mars sandbox off` runs it on {machine}.

desktop.native: This folder has {label} builds ({things}) that won't run in the Linux sandbox, so its chats run on {machine}. Turn the sandbox on for this project to use it anyway.
desktop.explicit: This folder has {label} builds ({things}) that won't run in the Linux sandbox; rebuilding them there replaces them with Linux builds that won't run on {machine}.
desktop.box: Chats here run in a Linux sandbox, not on {machine}; turn it off for this project in Settings to run them here.
